ceiling_fail_closed.required_evidence_or_repair: Retiring a kept surface needs its own admitted repair. auri-live-proof and sync-to-canonical write to the repository and are repository_dispatch targets. auri-authorization-intake binds github.token and dispatches. Their credentials belong only in the SKAP Vault inside KV, and moving them is outside this lane. Re-audited against live main on 2026-10-29 (round 60, no workflow file changed): auri-authorization-intake (push on five paths plus workflow_dispatch) holds actions: write and runs `gh workflow run auri-live-proof.yml` with github.token; auri-live-proof (workflow_dispatch plus repository_dispatch auri_deployment_ready) holds contents: write; sync-to-canonical (workflow_dispatch, a weekly schedule and repository_dispatch sync-to-canonical) holds contents: write and pull-requests: write and opens the canonical sync PR. The validation-dispatcher is the fourth. Three writers plus the dispatcher is the floor: a writer cannot run inside the read-only dispatcher, and folding the first two into one file would change the live-proof contract that the second is triggered by. The open path-selection PR StegVerse-Labs/StegTalk#47 changes the dispatcher and catalog only, not the workflow count.
